description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ampitiya Udagama South, Kandy Kadawath Hathara and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320391 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including details about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
